articles.title: FDA Rubber-Stamped Moderna's Flu mRNA Vaccine — And the Review Was a Disaster

articles.title: Pentagon and HHS Open Investigation Into COVID Vaccine Deaths Among Mandated Military Personnel
articles.summary: The Trump administration has launched a formal investigation into whether COVID-19 vaccines contributed to deaths among U.S. service members who were forced to get the shots under Biden's military mandate. The investigation represents the first official acknowledgment that mandatory vaccination of a captive population demands serious safety scrutiny.
